verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into an up Riposte; you win if you commit full ability rotations and let Q sustain outlast her passive healing.

brief.thesis: Renekton sits at 52.2% over 209 games here with a real solo-kill edge because his stun chain in W (Ruthless Predator) locks Fiora down while her only defensive tool, Riposte (W), can only parry a single basic attack, never an ability. That means every full-rotation all-in from Renekton goes through untouched, and the matchup is decided by whether he trades autos or abilities into her cooldown.

theirWindow.when: Riposte (W) is up as you close in
theirWindow.what: She'll try to bait an auto attack to parry it, gaining bonus Attack Damage and reflecting magic damage back at you. Hold your own autos in this window and lead the trade with abilities instead, since Riposte can't touch them.

yourWindow.when: Fury above 50 with W and E ready
yourWindow.what: Dash in with empowered E (Slice and Dice) for bonus damage and Armor reduction, then land empowered W (Ruthless Predator) for a three-hit, 1.5s stun that destroys any shield on her. Neither ability can be parried, so this combo guarantees full damage regardless of her Riposte.

start.why: Runs at 53.6% over 179 games and 72.5% pick — the extra AD and sustain matter directly here since Fiora's passive Duelist heals her on every hit, so you need your own damage-per-trade to keep pace.

boots.why: 88.6% pick, 55.5% win rate — Fiora leans on repeated autos through Burst of Speed (E), and flat damage reduction blunts that attack-speed window better than anything else on the list.

core.why: Opens the build in 60.6% of the highest-performing games; the burst-on-cooldown proc lines up with your empowered W/E all-in window.
Stacks Armor shred on top of your empowered E's own Armor reduction, compounding the damage advantage you already have in extended fights.
Most-picked third item (60.6% path) — the damage-over-time conversion and healing let you win prolonged trades against her passive sustain race.

runes.keystoneWhy: Most-picked page here (31.7%) — Conqueror's stacking damage and healing reward the exact pattern this lane demands: extended ability-driven skirmishes rather than short poke exchanges.

summoners.why: 89% pick rate and the best win rate on record (54.5%) — Ignite converts your existing solo-kill advantage into actual kills once your W stun locks her down.

playing.title: Bait Riposte before all-in
playing.detail: Riposte only parries a basic attack, not an ability. Throw a couple of harmless autos first to burn her 10-6s cooldown before you commit your real rotation.

playing.title: Lead trades with abilities, not autos
playing.detail: Since W and E can't be parried, your damage always lands through Riposte — reserve autos for after she's used it, not before.

playing.title: Track her free Q recast
playing.detail: Lunge can be cast a second time within a couple seconds at no cost. If she dashes in to trade, expect a second hit immediately after before you commit your own cooldowns.

playing.title: Don't try to kite her E window
playing.detail: Burst of Speed stacks Move Speed on every hit or Lunge she lands. Once she's active in a trade, fighting through it beats trying to run from it.

playing.title: Bank R before her Blade Waltz timer
playing.detail: Her ultimate deals high burst on the initial hits with diminishing returns after. Have Dominus's bonus Health up before extended skirmishes past level 6 rather than trading cooldowns evenly.

playing.title: Weave Q every trade for sustain
playing.detail: Cull the Meek heals off its own damage and both damage and heal increase above 50 Fury — this is your direct counter to her passive healing race.

playing.title: Shove waves before level 6
playing.detail: With a 52.2% head-to-head over 209 games and the solo-kill edge, push early to deny her Lunge poke angles and force a stagnant lane your sustain wins.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win-rate figures are pulled from measured games on the current patch; the combo timing and trade-pattern reasoning above is our own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being hit with Fiora’s Riposte (W) while in combat. Be careful of Vitals while building Fury to engage whenever your abilities come off cooldown.
